decisions.label: Spell size
decisions.note: Every creature spell's size, times its old size: bolts, trails, hits, ground marks, beams' width, status icons, pack specials (Ed, 2026-11-03: "Larger, extra Bloom"). 1: as before.

decisions.label: Spell opacity
decisions.note: How far each spell's own opacity is raised toward solid: 0 as before (a themed shot 0.45, a beam 0.65, a zone's tiles 0.6), 1 all solid.

decisions.label: Spell glow
decisions.note: The spells' halo, their glow through the crowns and the extra bloom round bolts, hits, beams and zones, times their old strength. 1: as before (no extra bloom).

decisions.label: Spell duration
decisions.note: How long hits, ground marks, quakes and trails last, times their old life (a hit 0.75 s, a mark 2.6 s, a quake's ground 1.4 s).

decisions.label: Zone density
decisions.note: The share of a lingering zone's tiles drawn (a puddle, fire, frost, a web): 0.25 every fourth, as before; 1 every one.

decisions.label: Ground marks
decisions.note: How opaque the mark a hit leaves on the ground starts (it was 0.12).
